notes: Multiple irregular-board fixes: AI and taps no longer land in holes, only the default border stays selectable, undo and replay keep the shape, restart keeps the column count; fixed garbled Chinese in the update notes; retrained AI model, stronger on irregular and rectangular boards
notes_zh: 修复异型棋盘多处问题：AI 与点击不再落进空洞、仅保留默认边界、悔棋与回放不丢形状、重开不丢列数；修复更新说明中文乱码；AI 模型重训，不规则与长方形棋盘上更强
